description: Example edge cases for LLM reference. Use these as inspiration to generate contextually relevant bugs based on participant's stakeholder-attribute selections.
usage: The LLM should analyze participant selections and generate a novel bug scenario inspired by these examples, not copy them directly.

edge_case_examples.system_failure: Queue system has no tiebreaker logic for simultaneous requests
edge_case_examples.edge_case: Two riders request at exact same timestamp

edge_case_examples.trigger: Accessible rider requests when only accessible vehicle is assigned to non-accessible rider
edge_case_examples.system_failure: System doesn't reassign accessible vehicle from normal request to accessible request
edge_case_examples.edge_case: Must unassign accessible vehicle from normal rider, reassign to accessible rider

edge_case_examples.system_failure: Missed optimization opportunity for sequential pickups
edge_case_examples.edge_case: Same car should be assigned regardless of request time within threshold

edge_case_examples.system_failure: Requests sorted by destination incorrectly merged into single assignment
edge_case_examples.edge_case: Two riders get combined into one assignment when carpool not enabled

edge_case_examples.trigger: All vehicles occupied but one near pickup will be available soon
edge_case_examples.system_failure: Rider cancels because no car assigned, but occupied car could have been pre-assigned
edge_case_examples.edge_case: Vehicle occupied=true but should still be assignable for future pickup

edge_case_examples.system_failure: First-in-first-out ignores that farther car might be better for earlier request
edge_case_examples.edge_case: Strict queue ordering produces suboptimal total distance

edge_case_examples.trigger: Long wait time triggers emergency assignment without occupancy check
edge_case_examples.system_failure: Hard rule: if wait > 15min assign closest car, but forgets to check if car is occupied
edge_case_examples.edge_case: Current passengers disrupted/rerouted to satisfy wait time bug

edge_case_examples.trigger: Later request's pickup is on-route to earlier request
edge_case_examples.system_failure: Strict request_time ordering ignores route optimization
edge_case_examples.edge_case: Rider 2's pickup is on way to Rider 1, and Rider 2's dropoff is Rider 1's pickup

edge_case_examples.trigger: Matched on distance but battery insufficient for full trip
edge_case_examples.system_failure: Battery check only validates pickup distance, not pickup + ride distance
edge_case_examples.edge_case: Vehicle can reach pickup but not final destination

edge_case_examples.trigger: Rider's phone dies after vehicle assigned
edge_case_examples.system_failure: No timeout logic for unresponsive riders
edge_case_examples.edge_case: All cars become assigned but unoccupied, effectively out of service

edge_case_examples.system_failure: No reassignment when farther car becomes faster due to traffic
edge_case_examples.edge_case: Accident makes assigned car's route impossible, farther car now faster

edge_case_examples.trigger: Short ride with long pickup distance yields negative profit
edge_case_examples.system_failure: Rejecting unprofitable rides undermines customer satisfaction
edge_case_examples.edge_case: Nearest car far away, ride is short, profit negative

edge_case_examples.system_failure: No tiebreaker logic causes infinite loop or undefined behavior
edge_case_examples.edge_case: Both cars unoccupied at same location, weighted equally

edge_case_examples.trigger: Rider cancels while vehicle en route
edge_case_examples.system_failure: Freed vehicle not reassigned to closer waiting rider
edge_case_examples.edge_case: Vehicle 1 now closer to Rider 2 than Rider 2's assigned vehicle

edge_case_examples.system_failure: Request accepted but unable to complete
edge_case_examples.edge_case: No validation of pickup against service boundaries

edge_case_examples.trigger: Occupied vehicle has shorter future distance but longer ETA
edge_case_examples.system_failure: Optimization ignores that occupied vehicle will be closer after current ride
edge_case_examples.edge_case: Vehicle 1 maximizes profit post-dropoff but has higher current ETA

edge_case_examples.trigger: Cancellation in previous batch frees better-fit vehicle
edge_case_examples.edge_case: Rider assigned in batch_1, but batch_0 cancel creates better match

edge_case_examples.trigger: Rider changes pickup after vehicle assigned
edge_case_examples.system_failure: No threshold for requiring new ride request
edge_case_examples.edge_case: Maximum delta in pickup before graceful unassignment required

edge_case_examples.trigger: In-ride destination change affects next assigned rider
edge_case_examples.edge_case: Rider 1 changes destination mid-ride, but Rider 2 already assigned to Vehicle 1 for after Rider 1
edge_case_examples.requirement_violated: Minimize ETA and pickup distance - following one requirement violates another
